caveats.statement: Charter School (Y/N) is stored as 0/1 but questions refer to 'non-chartered' meaning Charter = 0; mixing with 'N' string will miss rows
caveats.check_sql: SELECT DISTINCT `Charter School (Y/N)` FROM frpm

caveats.statement: Card power can be '*' or NULL for unknown/infinite power; filtering only on '*' misses NULL rows
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE power IS NULL OR power = '*'

caveats.statement: Card name contains apostrophes (e.g. Ancestor's Chosen) requiring escaping in SQL literals
caveats.check_sql: SELECT name FROM cards WHERE name LIKE '%''%' LIMIT 5

caveats.statement: yearmonth.Date is stored as YYYYMM string; date filters must use string prefixes, not date functions
caveats.check_sql: SELECT DISTINCT SUBSTR(Date,1,4) FROM yearmonth LIMIT 5

caveats.statement: transactions_1k.Time is a time string; hour-range filters need string comparison or time parsing
caveats.check_sql: SELECT Time FROM transactions_1k LIMIT 5

caveats.statement: District name for clients is in district.A2, not a dedicated name column; joining on wrong column loses rows
caveats.check_sql: SELECT A2 FROM district LIMIT 5

caveats.statement: Average salary is stored in district.A11 as text; numeric casting needed before comparison
caveats.check_sql: SELECT A11 FROM district LIMIT 5

caveats.statement: cardKingdomFoilId and cardKingdomId must both be non-null to count as 'powerful foil'; checking only one overcounts
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND cardKingdomId IS NULL

caveats.statement: Loan status codes C and D both mean running contract; filtering only 'C' misses in-debt loans.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM loan GROUP BY status

caveats.statement: Card type 'junior' is the issuance-after-transaction mode; 'gold' is the high-level card, not a separate column.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT type, COUNT(*) FROM card GROUP BY type

caveats.statement: Client gender uses 'F'/'M' codes, not 'Female'/'Male'.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT gender, COUNT(*) FROM client GROUP BY gender

caveats.statement: District A-columns are numeric codes; A3 is region name, A2 is district name, A11 is average salary, A12/A13 are 1995/1996 unemployment, A15 is 1995 crimes.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT A2, A3, A11, A12, A13, A15 FROM district LIMIT 5

caveats.statement: Driver finish time is NULL for drivers who did not finish; use positionText or time IS NOT NULL to filter finishers.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM driverStandings WHERE positionText IN ('R','D','E','W','F','N')

caveats.statement: Race year is in races.year, not derived from date; earliest year/month must use MIN(date) on races.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT MIN(year), MIN(date) FROM races

caveats.statement: Driver full name requires concatenating forename and surname; surname alone is ambiguous.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT forename, surname FROM drivers WHERE surname='Hamilton'

caveats.statement: Expense date is stored as text; month extraction needs string parsing (5th-6th chars) rather than MONTH().
caveats.check_sql: SELECT expense_date FROM expense LIMIT 5

caveats.statement: Budget amount vs spent vs remaining are separate columns; 'amount' is the allocated budget, not actual spend.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT amount, spent, remaining FROM budget LIMIT 5

caveats.statement: Circuit coordinates are split into lat and lng columns; a single 'coordinates' value does not exist.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT name, lat, lng FROM circuits WHERE name='Silverstone Circuit'

caveats.statement: Event status values may be inconsistently cased or spaced, so filtering status='Closed' can miss rows
caveats.check_sql: SELECT DISTINCT status FROM event

caveats.statement: Budget remaining can be negative when spending exceeds budget, so MIN(remaining) is needed to find the worst overrun
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM budget WHERE remaining < 0

caveats.statement: Hero attribute names have inconsistent casing (e.g. 'durability' vs 'Durability'), so exact-match filters miss rows
caveats.check_sql: SELECT DISTINCT attribute_name FROM attribute

caveats.statement: Gender values may be stored as codes rather than 'Male'/'Female', so gender filters can return zero rows
caveats.check_sql: SELECT DISTINCT gender FROM gender

caveats.statement: Patient Birthday may be stored as text, so YEAR() comparisons can fail or misparse
caveats.check_sql: SELECT Birthday FROM Patient LIMIT 5

caveats.statement: Thrombosis values may be stored as text, so numeric comparisons (Thrombosis=2) can miss rows
caveats.check_sql: SELECT DISTINCT Thrombosis FROM Examination

caveats.statement: Uric acid normal range differs by sex, so a single threshold misclassifies patients
caveats.check_sql: SELECT SEX, MIN(UA), MAX(UA) FROM Laboratory JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID GROUP BY SEX

caveats.statement: Patient sex is stored as single-letter codes, so filtering on 'female'/'women' must use SEX = 'F'
caveats.check_sql: SELECT SEX, COUNT(*) FROM Patient GROUP BY SEX

caveats.statement: Admission is a coded flag ('-' vs '+'), not free text, so 'outpatient clinic' must map to Admission = '-'
caveats.check_sql: SELECT Admission, COUNT(*) FROM Patient GROUP BY Admission

caveats.statement: Thrombosis severity is numeric-coded; 'most serious' means Thrombosis = '1', not the max numeric value
caveats.check_sql: SELECT Thrombosis, COUNT(*) FROM Examination GROUP BY Thrombosis

caveats.statement: Visit year is embedded in the free-text Description column, so year filters need string parsing
caveats.check_sql: SELECT Description FROM Patient WHERE Description LIKE '%1997%' LIMIT 5

caveats.statement: Age must be computed from Birthday, not stored directly
caveats.check_sql: SELECT ID, Birthday FROM Patient LIMIT 5

caveats.statement: Molecule label uses '+'/'-' codes, so 'carcinogenic' must be label = '+'
caveats.check_sql: SELECT label, COUNT(*) FROM molecule GROUP BY label

caveats.statement: Bond type uses symbol codes ('-','=','#'), so 'double bond' must be bond_type = '='
caveats.check_sql: SELECT bond_type, COUNT(*) FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type

caveats.statement: Atom IDs embed molecule and position (e.g. TR004_8), so atom 19 must be matched with LIKE 'TR%_19'
caveats.check_sql: SELECT atom_id FROM atom WHERE atom_id LIKE 'TR%_19' LIMIT 5

caveats.statement: Connections are stored in the connected table, so atoms with no bonds must be found via NOT IN connected
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected)

caveats.statement: Element values are lowercase codes, so 'carbon' must be element = 'c'
caveats.check_sql: SELECT element, COUNT(*) FROM atom GROUP BY element
